gross_claim_basis: Disclosed debt including leases KRW 24.646557tn plus KRW 0.7000tn run-date funding bridge and KRW 0.3500tn parent noncontrolling/other senior claim, each included once.

claim_bridge.note: The structural model adds eligible liquid assets back to enterprise assets and uses gross claims as the strike. The difference reproduces the audited legacy net-claim bridge exactly; it does not use net debt itself as debt face value.

asset_volatility_basis: Rounded annualized log-width implied by the audited Down/Upside business-value envelope over five years; no current share price is used.

branches.rationale: Integration and margin recovery materially miss plan; refinancing remains available only at restrictive terms.
Gradual operating recovery and integration execution broadly track the source-bound base underwriting.
Integration savings, aerospace/MRO conversion and cash generation reach the audited upside path.

probability_authorization.basis: Current merged-group history is short and predecessor panels are not yet OOS-qualified. The audited scenario values are retained as the value bridge and the integration outcome is an explicit, versioned 20/60/20 analyst prior. The central branch is the unique mode; probabilities do not come from nearest-anchor classification, and no segment posterior is claimed.
